title: Company in the News: BGI - The Wire China
gist: Two previously undisclosed deaths in Chinese gene-editing trials have renewed scrutiny of how China develops cutting-edge treatments and led U.S. lawmakers to call for limits on the use of Chinese medical trial data. The Wire China profiles BGI, the leader in China's genetics field, which was not involved in the trials. This is a paywalled teaser.

themes.theme: Gene-editing trial deaths and U.S. backlash

insights.claim: The revelation of two previously undisclosed deaths in Chinese gene-editing trials has prompted U.S. lawmakers to call for limits on the use of Chinese medical trial data.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Restrictions on Chinese trial data would hit Western biotechs that in-license Chinese assets or rely on China-run trials for FDA filings; watch for bill text and FDA guidance.
insights.quote: prompted U.S. lawmakers to call for limits on the use of Chinese medical trial data

insights.claim: Undisclosed deaths in Chinese gene-editing trials have renewed scrutiny of how cutting-edge treatments are developed in China, raising the regulatory and reputational risk premium on China-originated biotech.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Expect higher diligence costs and valuation discounts for China-sourced gene and cell therapy assets.

insights.claim: BGI leads China's genetics field across research, testing and treatment development, and was not involved in the gene-editing trials where the deaths occurred.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Even without direct involvement, BGI, already a U.S. policy target, is the likely lightning rod for any broader U.S. crackdown on Chinese genetic and trial data.
insights.quote: BGI, the leader in China’s genetics field from research to testing and treatment development (BGI wasn’t involved in the clinical trials deaths)
